steps.name: DESeq2 interaction model: condition x time
caveats: n=3 per condition/time cell is small; interaction test has limited power to detect anything but moderate-to-large differences in treatment effect size between time points
Confirm metadata column names/values (condition, time, time_hours) and factor levels before fitting; a mislabeled reference level silently flips the sign of the interaction
Do not interpret significant main effects as evidence of interaction — only the explicit condition:time term (or a direct t1-vs-t0 fold-change difference contrast) answers the stated question
steps.question: In this 2x2 design (condition x time, 3 replicates per cell, 12 samples), does the treatment effect (condition) differ between time point t0 and t1 — tested as the condition:time interaction term in a DESeq2 model fit on raw Salmon gene counts?
acceptance_criteria: Counts (12000 genes x 12 samples) and metadata (12 samples x condition/time/time_hours) are loaded and sample order/names are matched/verified between the two files before building the DESeqDataSet
A DESeqDataSet is built with design = ~condition + time + condition:time (condition and time coerced to factors with explicit reference levels)
DESeq() is run and results() extracts the interaction coefficient (condition:time term) with log2FoldChange, p-value and BH-adjusted p-value for all ~12000 genes

Simple/main effect contrasts are also extracted: treatment vs control at t0, and treatment vs control at t1 (via contrast or by relevelling / building the corresponding coefficient), each with full DESeq2 results tables

Output includes three results tables (interaction, t0 simple contrast, t1 simple contrast) as CSV, an MA/volcano plot for the interaction term, and a short text summary reporting the number of genes with significant interaction (padj < 0.05) and their overlap with genes significant at t0-only or t1-only
Independent filtering / outlier handling (Cook's distance) defaults from DESeq2 are left in place and reported, given n=3 per cell is on the low side

steps.name: Time-dependence summary of the treatment effect
caveats: This step is descriptive/diagnostic on top of the DESeq2 interaction test, not an independent statistical test — do not treat the scatter-based counts as a substitute p-value
steps.question: Among genes with a significant treatment effect at t0 and/or t1, how does the direction and magnitude of the condition log2 fold change compare between the two time points, and how many genes show a statistically significant interaction (padj < 0.05 on condition:time)?
acceptance_criteria: Merges the interaction results table with the t0 and t1 simple-contrast tables from T1S1 on gene symbol
Produces a scatter plot of t0 log2FC vs t1 log2FC for the union of genes significant in either simple contrast or the interaction term, colored by interaction significance (padj<0.05)
Reports counts: genes DE only at t0, only at t1, at both time points with concordant direction, at both with discordant/opposite direction, and genes with significant interaction term
Produces a final CSV table (gene, log2FC_t0, log2FC_t1, delta_log2FC, interaction_padj, t0_padj, t1_padj) sorted by interaction significance
Text summary explicitly answers whether the treatment effect differs by time point, citing the number of interaction-significant genes and example top genes

steps.name: Pathway enrichment of time-dependent treatment-responsive genes
caveats: 12000-gene background is smaller than a whole-genome background; use the actual tested gene universe (not a generic genome-wide default) as the enrichment background to avoid inflated significance
With modest gene-list sizes from an n=3-per-cell design, treat enrichment results as hypothesis-generating
steps.question: What WikiPathways human pathways are enriched among genes showing a significant condition:time interaction (treatment effect differing by time point), and separately among genes DE only at t0 vs only at t1?
acceptance_criteria: Uses the human WikiPathways gene set file available in the reference store (HGNC gene symbols) — if absent at run time, the step reports the gap and skips enrichment rather than substituting another species' gene sets

Runs over-representation or GSEA-style enrichment separately for: (1) interaction-significant genes (padj<0.05), (2) t0-only DE genes, (3) t1-only DE genes, each against the full expressed gene background (~12000 genes) from T1S1
Reports enriched pathways with adjusted p-value < 0.1 (or states none pass threshold) for each of the three gene sets, as a CSV plus barplot per set
Explicitly compares the top pathways between the t0-only and t1-only sets to characterize what biological processes differ in treatment response over time

plan.title: Treatment x time interaction DE analysis
plan.analytical_narrative: The design is a 2x2 factorial (condition x time) bulk RNA-seq experiment with 3 replicates per cell (12 samples, 12000 genes, single batch, raw Salmon counts). The research question — does the treatment effect differ between time points — is a classic condition:time interaction question, best answered with a single DESeq2 model containing both main effects and their interaction term, rather than separate pairwise contrasts at each time point. Step 1 builds the count matrix and metadata, fits ~condition*time in DESeq2, and extracts (a) the interaction term itself (the direct test of 'does the treatment effect differ by time'), and (b) the simple treatment-vs-control contrasts at t0 and at t1 for interpretability. Step 2 takes the interaction-significant genes (and the two simple contrasts) forward to WikiPathways enrichment to characterize what kind of biology the time-dependent treatment effect involves. Step 3 provides a diagnostic summary comparing the magnitude/direction of fold changes at t0 vs t1 for the union of DE genes, giving a concrete, plain answer to whether and how the treatment effect differs over time.
